overview: Use this event to review the familiarization EP set as one connected decision tree. You should be ready to move from recognition to memory items to PEL, forced-landing, or ejection logic without stopping to rebuild the picture.

studyNotes.headline: Discussion items

items.text: Treat this as a cumulative EP brief. The instructor can move quickly between recognition, memory items, and the branch logic that decides whether you continue, land, or eject.

children.text: Emergency Engine Shutdown on the Ground
Be able to state the recognition cue before you recite the steps.
Know the associated N/W/Cs, not just the memory items.
Have a clear answer for when the EP becomes a PEL, forced-landing, or ejection problem.

studyNotes.summary: Treat this like a cumulative EP check: know the cue, the immediate action, and the N/W/C that changes the safe answer.

summary: Cumulative emergency-procedure recognition, memory items, and N/W/C decision logic.
title: Emergency Procedures Review
